[b][size=4] Features [/size][/b] [list]
[*]can be placed [b]indoors [u]AND[/u] outdoors[/b]
[*][b]Grills[/b] = Portable functional kitchen (compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]; source: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/2182?jump_to_comment=123952854][b]here[/b][/url])

[*]Cushioned swing bench seats (3)
[*]Functional [b]water fountains[/b] (refill water can, etc) = face water fountains but keep cursor out of bounding-box tiles; prevent picking up furniture instead of prompting tile function (right click)
[*][s]Functional "freezer cooler box" chest (mini-fridge) ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url])[/s] (SDV 1.5)
